explication: xlskubectl is a browser-based bridge for viewing Kubernetes deployments in Google Sheets and changing desired replica counts from the spreadsheet. The user opens the served page, connects Google credentials, and the client loads deployments, synchronizes spreadsheet rows, and watches Kubernetes updates; spreadsheet edits can trigger deployment scaling. The source excerpt shows these responsibilities in one JavaScript file, so the nodes separate its main runtime roles rather than implying separate modules. The HTML’s implementation details and some event-handling branches were not sampled.
